title: The Mandela Rhodes Scholarship
about: The Mandela Rhodes Scholarship for young African leaders, Class of 2028, for African citizens aged 19 to 29 with an undergraduate degree. Applications open 9 March 2027 and close 14 April 2027 at 23:59 GMT+2; references must be uploaded by then.
requirements: Referees must upload references by the deadline; no late or incomplete applications
card_alt: Card for The Mandela Rhodes Scholarship offered by The Mandela Rhodes Foundation, deadline 14 Apr 2027, location not specified. The photo is a generic default image of a riverside city skyline at sunset with a tall tower (Landmark 81, Ho Chi Minh City), not the scholarship location.
